preconditions.description: The input k must be an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of vertices n in the output graph must be between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The output must contain exactly n+1 lines, where the first line is the number of vertices and the next n lines are the adjacency matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == int(stdout.split()[0]) for line in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each line of the adjacency matrix must have exactly n characters.

postconditions.expression: all(char in 'YN' for line in stdout.split()[1:] for char in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the adjacency matrix must be either 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.expression: all(line[i] == line[i] for i in range(int(stdout.split()[0])) for line in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The adjacency matrix must be symmetric (Gij = Gji).

postconditions.expression: all(line[i] == 'N' for i in range(int(stdout.split()[0])) for line in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: There must be no self-loops in the graph (Gii = 'N').
There must be an edge between vertex 1 and vertex 2 (G12 = 'Y').

postconditions.expression: len([path for path in all_shortest_paths(graph, 0, 1)] == int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: The number of shortest paths between vertex 1 and vertex 2 must be exactly k.
